```{r}
# Assign colors

blue1 <- "#d4e9f8"
blue2 <- "#9ed4ef"
blue4 <- "#007392"
blue5 <- "#00475d"

state_name <- "North Carolina"

axis_expansion_mult <- 0.5
```

```{r}
### set reentry 2030 project path
reentry_2030_cjars <- csg_get_project_path("reentry_2030_cjars")


### set path for exporting clean cjars data
reentry_2030_cjars_clean <- file.path(reentry_2030_cjars,
                                      "Data",
                                      "CJARS",
                                      "Clean")


#########################
### import files
#########################

#################
### state level
#################

### overall only
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_state_overall_only.rds"))


### with disaggregations
df_cjars_q3_state_raw <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_state_with_breakdowns.rds"))


#################
### county level
#################

### overall only
df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_county_overall_only.rds"))


### with disaggregations
df_cjars_q3_county_raw <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_county_with_breakdowns.rds"))


```

```{r }
### create 2 files:
### file 1. state means grouped by reentry/non-reentry 2030 states (excluding current state/page parameter)
### us-wide means for all measures including current state/page parameter
### we'll join these dfs throughout the qmd in order to provide visuals with trends for the current state, other reentry states, and the country as a whole

### grouping by reentry 2030 participation (reentry only)
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_reentry_grouping <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  dplyr::mutate(group = paste0("Other ",reentry_state_flag)) |> 
  ### filter out current state and non-reentry states
  filter(state_abbr!=state_abbr_param,
         group=="Other Reentry 2030 States") |> 
  group_by(group,
           cohort_year) |> 
  summarise(across(N_inc_to_inc_recid_y1:inc_mortality_y5,
                   mean,
                   na.rm=TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

### u.s. wide averages
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_nationwide <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  mutate(group = "U.S.") |> 
  group_by(group,
           cohort_year) |> 
  summarise(across(N_inc_to_inc_recid_y1:inc_mortality_y5,
                   mean,
                   na.rm=TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

#########################################
### now join all 3 groups together
### state, other reentry states, and u.s.
#########################################
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_state_reentry_us <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  filter(state_abbr==state_abbr_param) |> 
  mutate(group = state_abbr) |> 
  dplyr::select(group,
                cohort_year,
                N_inc_to_inc_recid_y1:inc_mortality_y5) |> 
  bind_rows(df_cjars_q3_state_overall_reentry_grouping,
            df_cjars_q3_state_overall_nationwide) 

```


# Reentry Trends in `r state_name`

**Note:** Throughout this analysis, I've used the earliest and latest year with available data -- this appears to differ depending on the county and metric. When possible, I've indicated the specific years used in the visual's tooltips. We may end up just wanting to include a single set of years (e.g. 2000 as earliest and 2021 as latest) to have consistency. 

I've used the 6 states listed on the reentry 2030 site (https://reentry2030.org/) as the group of reentry states throughout the analysis. Missouri and Alabama, though, appear to be missing from CJARS data so they're excluded from all analysis. 

<br>

## Recidivism


### Recidivism by county

```{r include=FALSE}

### pull in county names and population info
### county-level file
### pulling in population data in case we want to use it as tooltip
us_county_population <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "S0101_C01_001",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE,
  keep_geo_vars = TRUE,
  cb = TRUE,
  resolution = "20m") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(state_geoid = substr(geoid, 1, 2)) |>
  ### now drop geometry so that we can use as regular df (and not a spatial object)
  ### we initially needed geometry in order to extract county name without label (e.g., county, parish, area, etc.)
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  ### finally, keep and rename columns we'll use later
  dplyr::select(county_fips = geoid,
                acs_county_name = name_x,
                acs_county_pop = estimate,
                acs_county_state_name = state_name) |>
  distinct() |> 
  ### filter on state param
  filter(acs_county_state_name==state_name)


### add tooltip to mapping df
df_cjars_q3_county_recidivism_tooltip <- df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only |> 
  mutate(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_to_map = inc_to_inc_recid_y2*100) |>
  ### filter out years/counties with missing data
  filter(!is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y2)) |>
  group_by(county_fips) |> 
  ### now calculate % change over time from earliest year of data to latest year of data
  summarize(min_cohort_year = min(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            max_cohort_year = max(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_min_year = inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == min_cohort_year],
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year = inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == max_cohort_year],
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map = inc_to_inc_recid_y2_to_map[cohort_year == max_cohort_year]) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### right join in acs county file so that every county has a tooltip -- even
  ### if they are missing data from CJARS
  ### e.g. we want the map base file to include all counties
  right_join(us_county_population,
            by = "county_fips") |> 
  # ### removing counties' solved rate if they have fewer than 25 incidents reported in 2022
  # ### we want them grayed out on map
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(n_reported_2023<25,
  #                                    NA,solved_rate_2023)) |> 
  # ### recode any solved counts or rates less than 0 to 0
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(solved_rate_2023<0 & !is.na(solved_rate_2023),
  #                                    0,solved_rate_2023),
  #        n_solved_2023 = ifelse(n_solved_2023<0 & !is.na(n_solved_2023),
  #                                    0,n_solved_2023)) |>
  # ### convert solve rate from decimal to whole number -- for map legend
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = solved_rate_2023*100) |> 
  # # ### recode NaN and Inf values as NA
  # # mutate(across(.cols = solved_rate_percent_point_change_2019_2022, 
  # #               ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x) | is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) |> 
  # # ### add '+" in front of positive numbers and 0
  # # ### only for value we'll include in tooltip
  mutate(tooltip = case_when(
    !is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
    "<b>", acs_county_name," – ",max_cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "2-year recidivism rate in ",min_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_min_year, 1),
      "<br>",
      "2-year recidivism rate in ",max_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year, 1)
    ),
    # n_reported_2023<25 & !is.na(n_reported_2023) ~ paste0(
    #   "Agencies in ", county_clean, " did not report enough", "<br>",
    #   "data on solved crime to the FBI to", "<br>",
    #   "make reliable estimates (fewer than 25 incidents)."
    #   ),
    is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
       "<b>", acs_county_name, "</b><br>",
      "No 2-year recidivism data was reported by CJARS."
      )
    )) 

### extract state abbr for hc map pull
state_abbr <- tolower(head(df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only$state_abbr[!is.na(df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only$state_abbr)],1))

```


```{r }
#| fig-height: 5.5

### pull only state geo that we want for each param iteration
hcmap(
  paste0("countries/us/us-",state_abbr,"-all"),
  data = df_cjars_q3_county_recidivism_tooltip,
  value = "inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map",
  joinBy = c("fips","county_fips"),
  nullColor = "#E8E8E8",
  nullInteraction = TRUE,
  borderWidth = 0.45,
  borderColor = "black",
  accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "county: {point.acs_county_name}, rate: {point.value:.1f}"
        )
      )) |> 
  hc_title(
    text = "Recidivism Rate",
    align = "left",
    style = list(fontFamily = header_font, color = "#005FAD",
                              fontSize = "24px", fontWeight = "bold")
    ) |>   
    hc_subtitle(
    text = "2-year rates of reincarceration",
    align = "left",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts, fontSize = "16px",
                                 color = "#666666")
  ) |>
  hc_colorAxis(endOnTick = TRUE,
               startOnTick = TRUE,
               stops = color_stops(4, c(blue1,
                                        blue2,
                                        blue4,
                                        blue5)),
               labels = list(format = "{value}%",
                             style = list(fontSize = "12px",
                                          fontFamily = default_fonts))) |> 
  hc_legend(align = "center",
            horizontalAlign = "bottom",
            layout = "horizontal",
            # title = list(text = "Percent Change"),
            symbolHeight = 25,
            symbolWidth = 315,
            x = 0,
            y = 0
            ) |> 
     hc_tooltip(
        style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts),
        formatter = JS("function() {
        return '<div style=\"background-color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 1; padding: 8px; border: none;\">' +
        this.point.tooltip +
        '</div>';}"),
        useHTML = TRUE
      ) |>
  hc_setup()

```


### Recidivism rates over time 

::: {.panel-tabset}


#### 1-year reincarceration  

```{r }

to_plot <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_state_reentry_us |> 
    filter(!is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y1),
           !is.nan(inc_to_inc_recid_y1)) |> 
  ### arrange legend so that state name comes first followed by region name
  mutate(mean_rate = inc_to_inc_recid_y1*100,
         group = fct_relevel(group, 
                                          paste0("Other Reentry 2030 States"),
                                          paste0("U.S."),
                                          after = Inf),
    ### create tooltip
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", group, " – ", cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "Recidivism Rate (%): ", percent(inc_to_inc_recid_y1, 1)
      ))

rng <- range(to_plot$mean_rate)
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

y_min <- rng[1] - mult
y_min <- if_else(y_min < 0, 0, y_min)
y_max <- rng[2] + mult
  

### now plot
to_plot |> 
  hchart(
    "spline",
    hcaes(cohort_year, mean_rate, group = group),
    color = jr_pal[c(1,5,7)],
    dashStyle = c("solid","dash", "dash"),
    opacity = c(1, 0.75, 0.75),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "year: {point.x:.0f}, rate: {point.y:.1f}"
        )
      )      
  ) |> 
  hc_title(text = paste0("1-year reincarceration rates over time (averages)")) |>
  hc_caption(text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)") |>
  hc_yAxis(labels = list(format = "{value}%")) |>
  hc_setup()


```

## Employment


### Poverty rate by county

```{r include=FALSE}

### add tooltip to mapping df
df_cjars_q3_county_employ_tooltip <- df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only |> 
  mutate(inc_above_poverty_y3_to_map = inc_above_poverty_y3*100) |>
  ### filter out years/counties with missing data
  filter(!is.na(inc_above_poverty_y3)) |>
  group_by(county_fips) |> 
  ### now calculate % change over time from earliest year of data to latest year of data
  summarize(min_cohort_year = min(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            max_cohort_year = max(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            inc_above_poverty_y3_min_year = inc_above_poverty_y3[cohort_year == min_cohort_year],
            inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year = inc_above_poverty_y3[cohort_year == max_cohort_year],
            inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map = inc_above_poverty_y3_to_map[cohort_year == max_cohort_year]) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### right join in acs county file so that every county has a tooltip -- even
  ### if they are missing data from CJARS
  ### e.g. we want the map base file to include all counties
  right_join(us_county_population,
            by = "county_fips") |> 
  # ### removing counties' solved rate if they have fewer than 25 incidents reported in 2022
  # ### we want them grayed out on map
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(n_reported_2023<25,
  #                                    NA,solved_rate_2023)) |> 
  # ### recode any solved counts or rates less than 0 to 0
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(solved_rate_2023<0 & !is.na(solved_rate_2023),
  #                                    0,solved_rate_2023),
  #        n_solved_2023 = ifelse(n_solved_2023<0 & !is.na(n_solved_2023),
  #                                    0,n_solved_2023)) |>
  # ### convert solve rate from decimal to whole number -- for map legend
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = solved_rate_2023*100) |> 
  # # ### recode NaN and Inf values as NA
  # # mutate(across(.cols = solved_rate_percent_point_change_2019_2022, 
  # #               ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x) | is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) |> 
  # # ### add '+" in front of positive numbers and 0
  # # ### only for value we'll include in tooltip
  mutate(tooltip = case_when(
    !is.na(inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
    "<b>", acs_county_name," – ",max_cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "3-year poverty rate in ",min_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_above_poverty_y3_min_year, 1),
      "<br>",
      "3-year poverty rate in ",max_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year, 1)
    ),
    # n_reported_2023<25 & !is.na(n_reported_2023) ~ paste0(
    #   "Agencies in ", county_clean, " did not report enough", "<br>",
    #   "data on solved crime to the FBI to", "<br>",
    #   "make reliable estimates (fewer than 25 incidents)."
    #   ),
    is.na(inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
       "<b>", acs_county_name, "</b><br>",
      "No 3-year poverty data was reported by CJARS."
      )
    ))
```

## Housing


### HUD rental assistance by county

```{r include=FALSE}

### add tooltip to mapping df
df_cjars_q3_county_hud_tooltip <- df_cjars_q3_county_overall_only |> 
  mutate(inc_hud_y3_to_map = inc_hud_y3*100) |>
  ### filter out years/counties with missing data
  filter(!is.na(inc_hud_y3)) |>
  group_by(county_fips) |> 
  ### now calculate % change over time from earliest year of data to latest year of data
  summarize(min_cohort_year = min(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            max_cohort_year = max(cohort_year,
                                  na.rm=TRUE),
            inc_hud_y3_min_year = inc_hud_y3[cohort_year == min_cohort_year],
            inc_hud_y3_max_year = inc_hud_y3[cohort_year == max_cohort_year],
            inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map = inc_hud_y3[cohort_year == max_cohort_year]) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### right join in acs county file so that every county has a tooltip -- even
  ### if they are missing data from CJARS
  ### e.g. we want the map base file to include all counties
  right_join(us_county_population,
            by = "county_fips") |> 
  # ### removing counties' solved rate if they have fewer than 25 incidents reported in 2022
  # ### we want them grayed out on map
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(n_reported_2023<25,
  #                                    NA,solved_rate_2023)) |> 
  # ### recode any solved counts or rates less than 0 to 0
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = ifelse(solved_rate_2023<0 & !is.na(solved_rate_2023),
  #                                    0,solved_rate_2023),
  #        n_solved_2023 = ifelse(n_solved_2023<0 & !is.na(n_solved_2023),
  #                                    0,n_solved_2023)) |>
  # ### convert solve rate from decimal to whole number -- for map legend
  # mutate(solved_rate_2023 = solved_rate_2023*100) |> 
  # # ### recode NaN and Inf values as NA
  # # mutate(across(.cols = solved_rate_percent_point_change_2019_2022, 
  # #               ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x) | is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) |> 
  # # ### add '+" in front of positive numbers and 0
  # # ### only for value we'll include in tooltip
  mutate(tooltip = case_when(
    !is.na(inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
    "<b>", acs_county_name," – ",max_cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "3-year rental assistance rate in ",min_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_hud_y3_min_year, 1),
      "<br>",
      "3-year rental assistance rate in ",max_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_hud_y3_max_year, 1)
    ),
    # n_reported_2023<25 & !is.na(n_reported_2023) ~ paste0(
    #   "Agencies in ", county_clean, " did not report enough", "<br>",
    #   "data on solved crime to the FBI to", "<br>",
    #   "make reliable estimates (fewer than 25 incidents)."
    #   ),
    is.na(inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map)==TRUE ~ paste0(
       "<b>", acs_county_name, "</b><br>",
      "No 3-year HUD rental assistance data was reported by CJARS."
      )
    )) 


```

```{r }
  ### arrange legend so that state name comes first followed by region name
  mutate(mean_rate = inc_medicaid_y3*100,
         group = fct_relevel(group, 
                                          paste0("Other Reentry 2030 States"),
                                          paste0("U.S."),
                                          after = Inf),
    ### create tooltip
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", group, " – ", cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "Medicaid Enrollment Rate (%): ", percent(inc_medicaid_y3, 1)
      ))

rng <- range(to_plot$mean_rate)
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

y_min <- rng[1] - mult
y_min <- if_else(y_min < 0, 0, y_min)
y_max <- rng[2] + mult
  

### now plot
to_plot |> 
  hchart(
    "spline",
    hcaes(cohort_year, mean_rate, group = group),
    color = jr_pal[c(1,5,7)],
    dashStyle = c("solid","dash", "dash"),
    opacity = c(1, 0.75, 0.75),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "year: {point.x:.0f}, rate: {point.y:.1f}"
        )
      )      
  ) |> 
  hc_title(text = paste0("Medicaid enrollment rate")) |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Proportion of individuals enrolled in Medicaid, three years after release from prison (averages)",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts, fontSize = "16px",
                                 color = "#666666")
  ) |> 
  hc_caption(text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)") |>
  hc_yAxis(labels = list(format = "{value}%")) |>
  hc_setup()



```

## Reentry numbers by county

**Note:** Similar to the maps, I've pulled metrics from the latest year available -- this varies by county.

```{r}

### combine dfs used for maps -- pulling metric from latest year available
### for each given metric (which we already did df by df above)

### first create list of all dfs to join via state name/fips
df_cjars_map_data_list <- list(df_cjars_q3_county_ssi_tooltip,
                               df_cjars_q3_county_recidivism_tooltip, 
                               df_cjars_q3_county_employ_tooltip,
                               df_cjars_q3_county_hud_tooltip) 


### now merge all dfs -- keeping all states with at least one data point (via all = TRUE)
### select columns needed for table
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_to_table <- purrr::reduce(.x = df_cjars_map_data_list, 
                                                         merge, 
                                                         by = c("acs_county_name",
                                                                "county_fips",
                                                                "acs_county_state_name"), 
                                                         all = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::select(acs_county_name,
                county_fips,
                inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map,
                inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map) |> 
  ### there are some pure duplicates based on differing min and max cohort years 
  ### this doesn't impact the current table/analysis/need
  distinct()


### create state-level table
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_to_table |> 
    dplyr::select(acs_county_name,
           inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map,
           inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map) |> 
  reactable_template(
    sort_col = list("acs_county_name" = "asc"),
    columns = list(
      acs_county_name = colDef(name = "County"),
      inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "2-Year Recidivism Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "Poverty Rate (above poverty)",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "HUD Assistance Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 1)), 
      inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "SSI Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 1))
      )
    )

```
